articles.title: NASA completes second Artemis 2 fueling test
articles.summary:
NASA completed a second wet dress rehearsal for the Artemis 2 mission on Feb. 19 without any of the hydrogen leaks seen in the first such test earlier this month.

articles.title: Annular solar eclipse seen from space
Smile sets sail for Europe’s Spaceport in French Guiana
articles.summary: Just over a year since Smile arrived in the Netherlands in two parts, the now-complete and thoroughly-tested spacecraft has left for good. With a launch window set for 8 April – 7 May on a Vega-C rocket, the joint European-Chinese mission is almost ready to embark upon its unique space mission.
